fieldValues.title: Is a graph walk a core service or a query axis?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (3. Agents and clients walk the graph themselves), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. A core service (neighbours, reach, lineage) that clients call.
- B. An axis of DiscoveryQuery, so selection and walking are one mechanism.
- C. A query axis implemented on a core walk, with only the axis exposed (one way per goal).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which callers need a walk outside a selection, and whether one-way-per-goal forbids exposing both.
fieldValues.next_action: Inventory the walks clients built (srs-rust#1413, #1415, #1416) and classify each as selection or traversal.
